Package com.ucm.server.gameobjects

Class BotLLMOnline

java.lang.Object
com.ucm.server.gameobjects.Bot
com.ucm.server.gameobjects.BotLLM
com.ucm.server.gameobjects.BotLLMOnline
All Implemented Interfaces:
IPlayerNotificator
Direct Known Subclasses:
GeminiLLM
public abstract class BotLLMOnline extends BotLLM
Abstract class that represents an online LLM-based poker bot.

This class extends BotLLM and integrates an external Large Language Model (LLM) to make poker decisions based on the current game state.

The bot builds a structured prompt containing:

  • Player hand and board cards
  • Stack and pot size
  • Blinds
  • Action history
  • Estimated equity

The prompt is sent to the model, and the response is parsed to extract a valid poker action. The class ensures robustness by sanitizing invalid or unexpected outputs from the model.

Subclasses must implement BotLLM.callModel(String) to connect to a specific LLM provider (e.g., Gemini, OpenAI, etc.).
